exposure: intrathecal placebo (0.9% isotonic saline) with bupivacaine
outcome: time for requirement of first rescue analgesia
cohort: Sixty patients admitted for elective caesarean section under spinal anesthesia were randomized into two groups.
finding: Intrathecal dexmedetomidine significantly prolonged the mean post-operative duration of analgesia (270.25 minutes) compared to placebo (140.46 minutes) in patients undergoing elective caesarean sections.
